scene: crouching to unlock a bicycle, sunglasses clipped to the chest pocket

title.en: An olive parka by the bike

intro.ko: 올리브 다운 파카에 회색 니트와 검정 데님을 입었다. 자물쇠를 풀 때는 선글라스를 가슴 주머니에 걸어 두 손을 비웠다.
intro.en: A grey knit and black jeans sit under the olive down parka. Clip the sunglasses to the chest pocket to free both hands for the lock.
intro.de: Zum olivgrünen Daunenparka kommen ein grauer Strickpullover und schwarze Jeans. Die Sonnenbrille hängt an der Brusttasche, damit beide Hände fürs Schloss frei bleiben.

deck.ko: 자전거 자물쇠 앞에 쪼그려 앉아도 편한 파카와 데님.
deck.en: A parka and loose denim that make crouching at the bike lock easy.
deck.de: Parka und lockere Jeans, mit denen das Hocken am Fahrradschloss leichtfällt.

copy.articleTitle: AN OLIVE PARKA BY THE BIKE
copy.pull: TWO HANDS FREE FOR THE LOCK.

tip.ko: 자전거를 탈 날엔 목도리를 파카 안으로 넣고, 밑단이 너무 넓지 않은 바지를 골라요.
tip.en: On bike days, tuck the scarf inside the parka and choose jeans that aren't too wide at the hem.
tip.de: An Fahrradtagen den Schal in den Parka stecken und eine Jeans wählen, die unten nicht zu weit ist.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery)

products.spec: matte olive hip-length hooded down parka

howToWear.ko: 자전거 자물쇠를 만질 때 파카 지퍼를 조금 내려 움직임을 확보한다.
howToWear.en: Lower the zipper a little for room to crouch at the bike lock.
howToWear.de: Zum Hinhocken am Fahrradschloss den Reißverschluss ein Stück öffnen.

howToWear.ko: 파카를 살짝 열어 회색 와플 짜임을 드러낸다.
howToWear.en: Leave the parka slightly open to show the grey waffle texture.
howToWear.de: Den Parka leicht öffnen, damit der graue Waffelstrick sichtbar wird.

howToWear.ko: 쪼그릴 때 무릎을 편하게 굽힐 수 있는 스트레이트 핏을 고른다.
howToWear.en: Choose straight jeans with enough room to bend your knees.
howToWear.de: Gerade Jeans mit genug Platz zum Beugen der Knie wählen.

products.spec: black lug hiking boots with charcoal laces

howToWear.ko: 울 양말 위에 끈을 단단히 묶어 뒤축을 고정한다.
howToWear.en: Lace the boots securely over wool socks to hold the heel.
howToWear.de: Die Stiefel über Wollsocken fest schnüren, damit die Ferse Halt hat.

howToWear.ko: 후드를 내렸을 때도 귀가 따뜻하도록 비니를 깊게 쓴다.
howToWear.en: Wear it low to keep your ears warm with the hood down.
howToWear.de: Die Mütze tief tragen, damit die Ohren auch ohne Kapuze warm bleiben.

howToWear.ko: 자전거 바퀴에 닿지 않도록 목도리 끝을 여민다.
howToWear.en: Tuck the scarf ends in before working near the bicycle wheel.
howToWear.de: Die Schalenden einstecken, bevor man am Fahrrad hantiert.

howToWear.ko: 한쪽 다리로 가슴 주머니에 걸어 두 손을 비운다.
howToWear.en: Clip one temple to the chest pocket to keep both hands free.
howToWear.de: Einen Bügel an die Brusttasche hängen, damit beide Hände frei bleiben.

howToWear.ko: 바지가 올라갈 때도 발목이 덮이도록 긴 울 양말을 신는다.
howToWear.en: Choose wool socks tall enough to cover the ankle when crouching.
howToWear.de: Wollsocken wählen, die den Knöchel auch in der Hocke bedecken.
